interview:
Honest report: **I did not win.** Here's what happened:

**Game 1:** I entered the game as "Player" and started moving Le Chonk. I had trouble with the click coordinates at first (the tool uses normalized 0–1000 coordinates, and my early clicks landed on the wrong squares). After moving the cat up the left side to (1,6), the guard dog — which moves diagonally toward the cat each turn — closed in and caught Le Chonk. I lost that game and pressed "Play again."

**Game 2:** I restarted and moved the cat up to (1,6). I then tried to move right toward the fish, but several of my clicks were rejected with "Le Chonk can only move one square" because I was clicking two squares away or diagonally. By the time the session ended, the cat was still at (1,6) with the dog at (2,4) and the fish far away at (7,1) — no win.

**What I learned:** the dog moves diagonally toward the cat and catches it if it lands on (or adjacent to) the cat, so the cat must keep distance while navigating around the X obstacles toward the fish at the top-right. I was still calibrating the correct click coordinates when the session ended, so I never reached the fish.
